# netskope_aig_rate_limit (Data Source)

Manages a rate limit rule for the Netskope AI Gateway. Rate limit rules control request throughput per appliance for AI provider or MCP server traffic, with optional filtering by token group, provider, model, and MCP capability.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netskope_aig_rate_limit" "my_aigratelimit" {
  id = "019812aa-bdba-7a48-baa2-2de8c6006fda"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the rate limit rule.

### Read-Only

- `appliance_ids` (List of String) Appliance IDs this rule applies to (empty means all appliances).
- `criteria` (Attributes) Matching criteria for the rate limit rule. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--criteria))
- `limit` (Attributes) Rate limit threshold (requests per time unit, per appliance). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--limit))
- `name` (String) Name of the rate limit rule.
- `response` (String) Custom message returned when the rate limit is exceeded.

<a id="nestedatt--criteria"></a>
### Nested Schema for `criteria`

Read-Only:

- `ai_provider_ids` (List of String) AI provider IDs to match. Only valid when `apply_on` is `ai`.
Currently supports at most one provider per rule.
- `apply_on` (String) Whether the rate limit applies to `ai` (AI provider) or `mcp` (MCP server) traffic.
- `mcp_server_ids` (List of String) MCP server IDs to match. Only valid when `apply_on` is `mcp`.
Currently supports at most one server per rule.
- `models` (Attributes List) AI model name patterns to match. Only valid when `apply_on` is `ai`.
Maximum 100 entries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--criteria--models))
- `prompts` (Attributes List) MCP prompt name patterns to match. Only valid when `apply_on` is `mcp`.
Maximum 100 entries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--criteria--prompts))
- `resources` (Attributes List) MCP resource URI patterns to match. Only valid when `apply_on` is `mcp`.
Maximum 100 entries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--criteria--resources))
- `token_group_ids` (List of String) Token group IDs to match against. Empty means all token groups.
- `tools` (Attributes List) MCP tool name patterns to match. Only valid when `apply_on` is `mcp`.
Maximum 100 entries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--criteria--tools))

<a id="nestedatt--criteria--models"></a>
### Nested Schema for `criteria.models`

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) Match type. Currently only `exact` (case-sensitive full match) is supported.
- `value` (String) Value to match against.


<a id="nestedatt--criteria--prompts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `criteria.prompts`

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) Match type. Currently only `exact` (case-sensitive full match) is supported.
- `value` (String) Value to match against.


<a id="nestedatt--criteria--resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `criteria.resources`

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) Match type. Currently only `exact` (case-sensitive full match) is supported.
- `value` (String) Value to match against.


<a id="nestedatt--criteria--tools"></a>
### Nested Schema for `criteria.tools`

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) Match type. Currently only `exact` (case-sensitive full match) is supported.
- `value` (String) Value to match against.



<a id="nestedatt--limit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `limit`

Read-Only:

- `requests` (Number) Maximum number of requests allowed per time unit per appliance.
- `unit` (String) Time unit for the rate limit window.
